comment: The section says a component “earns” DPI-H designation by satisfying a set of criteria. However, it does not explain the assessment method used to determine that every component in the proposed architecture satisfies those criteria.

anchor.note: p.63-64 l.Lines 544-549 read as the printed page; section 3.5.1 agrees

public.text: The section says a component “earns” DPI-H designation by satisfying a set of criteria. However, it does not explain the assessment method used to determine that every component in the proposed architecture satisfies those criteria.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a component-assessment matrix showing how each proposed component meets the defining criteria, including any partial compliance, exceptions, or context-dependent classification.
